_doc: Per-window observing geometry, one row per released window: the DISH DIAMETER of the array that took it, the longest baseline, the synthesised beam, the epoch and the parallax. Deposited because two things in the paper need the dish diameter and the released catalogue does not carry it: the primary-beam response column (whose only other geometry column, theta_pb_arcsec, is the pipeline's 1.22 lambda/D at 12 m for every row), and the parallactic offset expressed in synthesised beams. Harvested by /data/SETI/px/harvest.py from each window's own measurement set and the archive metadata; 1655 rows, of which the 1651 released ones are used here.
